text:
DeployBot: Deploy queued: release/2.14.0 -> prod in 10m. Feature flags to ramp: ml-serving-v2 (start 5% -> 50% over 30m), rerank-v3 (10% -> 100% over 1h).
joan: Heads-up — I'll watch query latency for ml-serving. If p95 > 450ms for two consecutive 5m windows, rollback.
alex: Can we start ml-serving at 2% instead? We've seen burst errors on canary.
maya: +1 for 2%. Also we should pin model version on serving nodes: model:v2.0.3
sam: DeployBot: auto-apply flag template 'ramp-small' scheduled. Command run: `/ff set ml-serving-v2 pct=2 duration=30m rollout=linear pin_version=model:v2.0.3`
ops-oncall: I'll keep the traffic slice pinned to eu-west1 for the first 20m. Alert if error-rate > 1%.
joan: Added alert: `ml-serving-error-rate > 0.8%` in 5m window. Dashboard: https://dash/re/runs/23
alex: Noted. If we see latency + errors, we'll flip ml-serving-v2 back to 0 and route to model:v1
maya: @sam please don't auto-scale canary beyond 4 replicas until 15m.
DeployBot: Canary scaled to 3/4 replicas as tolerated.
sam: rolling out rerank-v3 at 10% only after ml-serving stable for 30m.
ops-oncall: If rerank-v3 causes score drift >5% vs baseline on eval-set, rollback.
joan: 5m before deploy: locking release notes: "2.14.0: ml-serving v2 rollout (opt-in), rerank v3 experimental".
alex: small nit: add explicit fallback note: "Fallback: model:v1 pinned for critical paths"
maya: @sam starting ramp now: `/ff set ml-serving-v2 pct=2` — executing
sam: Confirmed. Starting ramp. Monitoring... :eyes: 
DeployBot: ml-serving-v2 pct=2 applied at 1768881235
joan: seeing slight p95 bump +30ms, error-rate 0.3% — acceptable.
ops-oncall: Keeping eu-west1 slice at 100% for pinned traffic, no cross-region yet.
sam: ramping to 10% after 10m if stable.
DeployBot: Scheduled next step: pct=10 at 1768881295
alex: if anything >0.8% errors, rollback instantly. I'll prep rollback note.
maya: 11m in: cancelling rerank ramp until ml-serving hits 50% stable.
sam: ack. Cancelling rerank auto-step.
DeployBot: rerank-v3 ramp canceled per admin.
joan: 22m: ml-serving p95 back to baseline, error-rate 0.2%. Proceed to 50% per plan.
sam: executing `/ff set ml-serving-v2 pct=50`
DeployBot: ml-serving-v2 pct=50 applied at 1768881356
ops-oncall: Monitoring logs. No anomalies.
alex: OK to unpin eu-west1 after 30m.
maya: I'll draft a short release note update and add rollback playbook snippet.
joan: TL;DR: rolled ml-serving-v2 to 50%, rerank-v3 paused. No rollback needed. We'll close thread after 1h stable.
